title: Simple Herobrine Mod
description: A Herobrine mod only you can summon that was made only to scare your friends. (Read description.)
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94dd0a59271b3db9895aa5fffa7d5ac37c7feeef.png) **A Herobrine mod, only to scare your friends.**
# About **Simple Herobrine Mod** is a mod that was made only to directly scare your friends by placing Herobrine in a distant place; letting it stare at your friend and make cave noises, and if they then try to go catch Herobrine, Herobrine will disappear when they are 20 blocks near it. # Features - Herobrine despawns when someone in survival mode is 20 blocks near. - If you are in Creative Mode, Herobrine doesn't disappaer so that you can place it without immediately despawning. - Herobrine makes random cave noises. - Herobrine stares at the closest player. - Herobrine doesn't move from where you place it.
